verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API with full programmatic access to feature flags and an official MCP server that lets LLM coding assistants create and manage flags. Its change requests can require up to 10 approvals before any change is made in an environment, which is the approval gate the story asks for. missing for 10: explicit documentation that API/MCP-originated writes are routed into change requests rather than bypassing them, explicit evidence of toggling (not just creating) via MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven changes being held for approval.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can create and toggle flags through documented APIs, CLIs, or MCP — and the platform can force my changes through approval workflows instead of letting me write to production unreviewed

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.
You can require up to 10 approvals for a change request.
